title: The jury in LA's social media trial finds Meta and YouTube harmed a young user via addictive design features and orders them to pay her $3M; Meta will pay 70% (New York Times)
summary: New York Times: The jury in LA's social media trial finds Meta and YouTube harmed a young user via addictive design features and orders them to pay her $3M; Meta will pay 70% — A jury found the companies negligent in their app designs, harming a young user with design features that were addictive and led to her mental health distress.
